annotations.title: Get restatement metric timeline for a statement identity

description:
Return the restatement timeline and per-metric deltas for a specific statement identity across the SEC filings that reported it, in acceptance order. Each filing counts once, as its current figures.

A period the filer has reported once has never been restated, and is answered with an empty timeline: `total_hops` is 0, `by_metric` is empty and `timeline_severity` is `NONE`. That is a complete answer rather than missing data, and it is also what a period with two filings that differ in no metric returns.

A statement identity no filing reported is answered with 404 `EDGAR_STATEMENTS_NOT_FOUND`.

One fiscal identity can hold several period ends, because a quarter is sometimes labelled FY. A timeline covers the revisions of a single period: the one the statement routes return. A fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods, each with its own timeline; `statement_date` names the one to return, and without it the later period's is returned.

A later filing can repeat an earlier filing's figures unchanged. Each run of such filings counts as one hop, ending on its latest filing, unless `include_unchanged_filings=true`.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period code (e.g., FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year for the statement identity.

include_unchanged_filings.description: Include hops to filings that repeated the figures served before them. By default the timeline hops from the first report to each filing that restated the period, so every hop is a change in what it serves.

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Names the period to compare when the identity reports more than one: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods, and each is compared across filings on its own. Without it the comparison covers the later period. A date that names no period of the identity answers 404, listing the dates in `details.available_statement_dates`.
